title: Chat/set and Message/set return oldState: null — RFC 8620 deviation
description: Both Chat/set and Message/set hardcode oldState: null in the response. RFC 8620 §5.3 requires oldState to be the state before the set was applied. Any client that uses oldState for cache consistency (e.g. to detect concurrent modifications) will silently get wrong behavior. This will fossilize as clients write code around the null.
